spots.name: Red Cliffs Water Tower Mural
tags: artist: Clark Barrett & Red Cliffs Secondary College Students
spots.blurb:
You've reached Red Cliffs Water Tower Mural, a mural by Clark Barrett & Red Cliffs Secondary College Students. A pictorial expression of the history of Red Cliffs,
undertaken by students from the Red Cliffs Secondary College in 1991, under the direction of Broken Hill artist Clark Barrett. The project, funded by the local branch of the Australian Dried Fruits Asso.
